versions.changelog:
- Initial release of "global-travel-planner" skill.
- Offers personalized global travel planning with visualized route maps (overall and daily), weather forecasts, local activity recommendations, and intelligent budget calculations.
- Generates high-quality PDF itineraries including route maps, daily plans, accommodation, dining, budget details, and packing lists.
- Supports keyword triggers in both Chinese and English.
- Ensures professional and user-friendly communication with travel tips and insider advice.
